mushroom.note: Genuine 16-frame wobble cycle, not an emerge capture. Emerge motion must be supplied by gameplay.

provenance.ripper: Mario Wiki uploader Cheese Head; original ripper not identified in file metadata
provenance.method: Original image downloaded by headless Playwright Chromium; lossless RGBA extraction, no enlargement.

coin_pop.note: Actual 16-frame coin spin usable as the sprite of a coin-pop effect. Pop trajectory is renderer movement; no captured rise/burst claimed.

provenance.game: Super Mario Maker (NSMBU style), collection labelled NSMBU
provenance.ripper: Random Talking Bush (credited in MarioTheBest project notes); image collection shared by MarioTheBest
provenance.method: Extract PNG image costumes only; no Scratch code reused. Verify exact 2x2 pixel replication and decimate by 2 to restore native pixels. Original costume order preserved. Playback rate is a chosen presentation rate, not a verified game clock.

star.note: Actual 21-frame Super Star wobble, usable as a decorative star effect. This is the power-up sprite, not an invincibility-particle rip.

provenance.ripper: Original ripper not credited by smm2viewer mirror
provenance.method: Lossless crop of four actual debris cells from pinned native tileset. Pieces are independent static particle variants, never played as an animation.

brick_debris.note: Four native fragment variants; select a piece for each particle. No brick was quartered or hand-painted to invent debris.
